finding: The invoice BL-2026-1187 shows a unit price and net total of 380.00 EUR for 'Expresszustellung Ersatzteile', exceeding purchase order PO-2026-0004 which was ordered and goods-receipted (WE-2026-0003) at 320.00 EUR net. According to the rulebook, a reviewer must verify with the responsible purchasing agent whether a price increase was agreed upon. If no price change was approved, the supplier must be requested to issue a corrected invoice or credit note for the 60.00 EUR net difference.
email_subject: Preisabweichung bei Rechnung BL-2026-1187 zu Bestellung PO-2026-0004
email_body:
Guten Tag,

bei der Prüfung Ihrer Rechnung BL-2026-1187 vom 09.11.2026 ist eine Abweichung zu unserer Bestellung PO-2026-0004 aufgetreten.

In der Rechnung wurde für die Position 'Expresszustellung Ersatzteile' ein Einzelpreis von 380,00 EUR netto angesetzt. Gemäß unserer Bestellung beträgt der vereinbarte Preis jedoch 320,00 EUR netto.

Bitte prüfen Sie den Vorgang und senden Sie uns eine entsprechende Rechnungskorrektur oder Gutschrift über den Differenzbetrag zu.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Ihre Kreditorenbuchhaltung

sections.text:
1. Look at the order and its goods receipts: was the quantity delivered, at which price was it
   ordered?
2. If the price was agreed later (a price increase, Preiserhöhung), the buyer who placed the order
   confirms it in writing and the order is updated; then reopen the invoice.
3. Otherwise ask the supplier for a credit note (Gutschrift) or a corrected invoice
   (Rechnungskorrektur) at the ordered price.
sections.title: PO match: invoice against purchase order
sections.heading: How to resolve a price above the order

sections.text:
Pairing by position means reordered or split lines show false differences. Compare item names
before asking the supplier.
sections.title: PO match: invoice against purchase order
sections.heading: Lines in another order

sections.text:
- Unit price: more than **0.01** above the order fails; below the order is a warning.
- Quantity: any quantity above the order fails; below the order is a warning (partial delivery,
  Teillieferung).
- Net total above the order by more than 0.01 fails; below it warns.
- A line that is not on the order, another unit, another currency, or an order of another supplier
  fails.
- An order number that is not in the order data is a warning.
